experience.summary: Senior engineer owning backend development and architecture for a global fashion retailer's core commerce solution, plus the API layer behind a retail mobile app.
highlights: Drove backend development and architecture for a global fashion retailer, taking full ownership of the core commerce solution.
Implemented secure payment gateways including Checkout.com, Paymob and Apple Pay, and developed a buy-now-pay-later cartridge.
Designed and built SCAPI integrations, Jobs and Services to power a Middle East lifestyle retail group's mobile app, turning cross-functional requirements into scalable API contracts.
Redesigned high-traffic PLP and PDP interfaces across the discovery-to-cart journey.
Own technical design decisions and sprint planning, mentor junior engineers, and partner with product and architecture stakeholders to evaluate trade-offs early.

experience.summary: Backend developer on a headless commerce programme for a global luxury fashion house, covering production support, jobs, services and integrations.
highlights: Supported the production environment, investigating issues, monitoring system health and resolving incidents.
Developed jobs and services for order exports, OMS processing and payment settlements.
Worked in a headless architecture on Node.js, building backend logic for checkout, payments and order placement.
Handled data and its integration across multiple systems, including payment, fraud detection and OMS providers.
Worked on performance improvements, order success and order recovery flows.
Trained and guided peers, and maintained documentation that kept delivery predictable.

experience.summary: Cart, checkout and fulfilment engineering for a US specialty retailer, plus a marketplace storefront built from the ground up.
highlights: Re-architected a US specialty retailer's cart with custom plugins and tuned configuration.
Designed and shipped multi-shipment, in-store pickup and same-day delivery capabilities, and integrated PayPal and Klarna payment flows end to end.
Built a custom marketplace PLP/PDP for a client from the ground up, owning technical design, documentation and cross-functional delivery.
Developed automated test suites and administration scripts that raised release reliability and caught regressions earlier.
Diagnosed production bugs, drove targeted performance work, and stood up monitoring to track system health over time.

experience.summary: First commercial engineering role, covering storefront backend work and a full Java system delivered end to end.
highlights: Built backend logic for PLP, PDP and cart on the SFRA framework as part of full-stack e-commerce feature delivery.
Developed a Java and Hibernate academic management system end to end, from requirements gathering through deployment.
